# Repository maintenance checklist

This repository contains the upstream Awesome list/template and is not a standalone software product. GitHub Issues are disabled here, so this file is the repository's local completion record.

## Confirmed from the current repository

- The README presents the Awesome list and links to the manifesto and contribution guidance.
- The repository includes a workflow under `.github/workflows/`.
- This repository is not counted as a product release target.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Confirm whether this repository is intended to remain an upstream fork/template or contain a maintained, project-specific list.
- [ ] Compare local changes with upstream and record the intended ownership and attribution.
- [ ] If project-specific entries exist, review each entry against the Awesome inclusion criteria and check its link.
- [ ] Review the existing workflow and contribution guidance; record any required corrections.
- [ ] Submit required changes through a pull request and confirm workflow checks pass.
- [ ] If this is an unchanged reference fork, record that decision and close this maintenance task without creating a product release.

## Next action

Document the repository's intended role and its delta from upstream, then make only the necessary changes through a pull request.
